narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5489 Prefer-A 6065006497)

1. Operative closed-findings: on Stop 1 + brief; composite identity (source-comment id + finding id); titles display-only; disposition enum only; Forbidden-inputs carve; freeze list in Round-1 dispatch input.
2. Closure authority: completed disposition or explicit operator closure; no title-only / unauthenticated suppression.
3. Match / relation key: composite identity + explicit restates: relation; no NLP clustering.
4. Critic method MUST demote authorized unchanged restatements to footnote/omit.
5. Parent unify MUST compose with disposition denominator; no silent drop; ADR-006 on contested equivalence.
6. Evidence-bearing reopen governs demotion/refusal; paired fixtures including reopen survives residual gate.
7. Docs + thin skill + fixture-level refuse consumer; live parent-turn MAY stay unenforced in v1.
8. Keep out: cross-issue memory; auto body rewrite; host LLM memory; resume-only; #5488 absorb; NLP clustering. Auto-seed MAY.
9. P1 honesty: deliverable remainder is exact declared-relation restatement + product field (P2–P4). Adjacent-polish hydra beyond that is leftover #5493.

Reject: B/C/D; silent drop; title-only suppression; closure immunity; claiming full P1 hydra from exact demotion alone.
operator-deferred: P1 #5493
